name: Trials of Tait
source: You play as a young college student, living at home with your parents. You're flunking pretty bad, on the verge of getting kicked out! Luckily, your Mom, Katherine, proposes a solution that will change your lives forever... Can you handle the challenge that Katherine and the many other women of Greenville will throw at you?​
translation: 你是一名年轻的大学生，住在父母家里。你的成绩一塌糊涂，快要被学校开除了！幸好，妈妈Katherine提出了一个能永远改变你们人生的解决方案……你能应付Katherine和Greenville其他女性带给你的挑战吗？
